title: [CON2-1] Community channel admission key: served to every role holder, or only to speakers?
description: Review finding CON2-1: Community channel admission key: served to every role holder, or only to speakers? (lens CON2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:311; spec/05-messaging.md:49, :132. Fix: Real contradiction. 03 §3.4 serves "to members permitted to read the channel (a role whose `channelAccess` covers it ...)" with no `community` exception; 05 §5.2.1 says the CO serves the key "only to members of the speaker group" and §5.2.1.2 says non-speakers "are not served the channel's admission key". The Space endpoint has no speaker list (speaker-group membership is MLS state; Space state holds only `speakerBot`). agora-doorkey-B ("served to authenticated members by the Space endpoint, rotated on removals") does not say whether "members" means channel role holders or MLS group members, and agora-broadcast-decision's "non-speakers can't read" is satisfied by MLS either way. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
